personal.bio: .NET Backend Developer specializing in architecting resilient RESTful APIs with ASP.NET Core and distributed .NET microservices. Experienced in Clean Architecture, CQRS, and enterprise design patterns, backed by automated testing with xUnit/Moq. Passionate about DevOps, Docker, Kubernetes, and automated CI/CD pipelines.

status.text: Open for Full-time Roles & High-Impact Engineering Opportunities

story: I am a .NET Backend Engineer and DevOps practitioner studying Computer Engineering at Benha University (Class of 2027) with an Excellent grade (92%).

My engineering journey is driven by designing resilient, scalable backend ecosystems. I architect and deliver complex distributed systems—ranging from high-performance Modular Monoliths with MediatR and Transactional Outbox, to polyglot microservices systems with YARP/Ocelot API gateways, RabbitMQ event-driven messaging, and Kubernetes orchestration.

Through intensive hands-on programs at the Digital Egypt Pioneers Initiative (DEPI), the Information Technology Institute (ITI), and Route Academy, I bridge the gap between software development and cloud operations with automated CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and infrastructure as code.

projects.title: eshop-modulith — Modular Monolith eCommerce
projects.tagline: .NET 10 eCommerce Modular Monolith with MediatR & Hand-built Transactional Outbox.
projects.description: .NET 10 eCommerce app built as a Modular Monolith: Catalog, Basket, and Ordering modules in one deployable, each with its own PostgreSQL schema, communicating via MediatR and Transactional Outbox + RabbitMQ.
projects.fullDescription: Built to explore direct architectural trade-offs against microservices. Modules (Catalog, Basket, Ordering) reside in a single deployable with per-module PostgreSQL schemas, communicating in-process via MediatR. Uses a hand-built Transactional Outbox pattern with RabbitMQ to publish cross-module domain events reliably without distributed transaction overhead. Features Vertical Slice Architecture (VSA), DDD, CQRS, Keycloak authentication, Redis caching, Seq structured logging, and full Dockerization.
keyFeatures: Isolated modules (Catalog, Basket, Ordering) with per-module PostgreSQL schemas
In-process asynchronous messaging via MediatR and custom Transactional Outbox
Event-driven cross-module communication using RabbitMQ broker
Keycloak OAuth2/OIDC authentication, Redis caching, and Seq centralized logging

projects.title: eshop-microservices — Distributed Event-Driven Architecture
projects.tagline: 4 independently deployable services behind YARP API Gateway with RabbitMQ & gRPC.
projects.description: .NET 10 e-commerce microservices system: Catalog, Basket, Discount, and Ordering services behind a YARP API Gateway, each with its own database, MassTransit/RabbitMQ events, and gRPC communication.
projects.fullDescription: Complete microservices ecosystem featuring 4 independently deployable services (Catalog, Basket, Discount, Ordering) configured behind a YARP (Yet Another Reverse Proxy) API Gateway. Leverages polyglot persistence (Marten/PostgreSQL document store, SQL Server, SQLite), asynchronous event-driven messaging via MassTransit and RabbitMQ, high-performance gRPC synchronous service-to-service calls, CQRS, Vertical Slice Architecture, and a Razor Pages storefront. Fully dockerized.
keyFeatures: YARP API Gateway routing, rate-limiting, and header forwarding
Polyglot persistence: Marten Document DB, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, and SQLite
Asynchronous event-driven communication using MassTransit and RabbitMQ
Sub-millisecond inter-service communication via gRPC protocols

projects.title: eCommerce Microservices on Kubernetes (AKS)
projects.tagline: 5-repository enterprise microservices suite deployed to Kubernetes with CI/CD.
projects.description: 5-repository microservices eCommerce architecture (Users, Products, Orders, Gateway, Infrastructure) with polyglot persistence, Ocelot Gateway, Redis cache invalidation, Polly resilience, and Kubernetes deployment.
projects.fullDescription: Enterprise 5-repository microservices architecture organized under the 'ym-harsha-ecommerce-microservices' organization. Features polyglot persistence (PostgreSQL + raw Dapper for Users, MySQL for Products Minimal API, MongoDB for Orders orchestration hub), Ocelot API Gateway, RabbitMQ event-driven Redis cache invalidation, Polly resilience policies (Retry, Circuit Breaker, Timeout, Bulkhead), and automated GitHub Actions CI/CD to a self-hosted Kubernetes cluster.
keyFeatures: 5 dedicated repositories: Users API, Products API, Orders API, Gateway, and Infrastructure
Ocelot API Gateway with rate limiting and response caching
RabbitMQ background worker event-driven Redis cache invalidation
Automated deployment to Kubernetes (Minikube / AKS) via GitHub Actions CI/CD

projects.title: Clean Architecture Web API & Azure Services
projects.tagline: 8-layer Clean Architecture sample focused on MediatR, Commands, and Handlers.
projects.description: .NET Clean Architecture template implementing an 8-layer separation of concerns with thin API controllers, MediatR Commands/Handlers, EF Core, FluentValidation, and Azure cloud integration.
projects.fullDescription: A production-tested Clean Architecture boilerplate designed to standardize enterprise backend development. Follows strict layer separation (Domain, Application, Infrastructure, Persistence, API), CQRS pattern with MediatR request and notification handlers, pipeline behaviors for FluentValidation, structured logging with Serilog, and seamless Azure Services integration.
keyFeatures: Strict Domain, Application, Infrastructure, Persistence, and API layer boundaries
CQRS pattern using MediatR request handlers and validation pipelines
Comprehensive Swagger/OpenAPI documentation with JWT bearer token support
Azure Services integration and cloud deployment readiness

projects.description: Restaurants API built with Clean Architecture, CQRS (MediatR), EF Core, AutoMapper, FluentValidation, pagination/sorting/filtering, resource-based authorization, Serilog, and Azure integrations.
projects.fullDescription: Engineered with Clean Architecture and CQRS (MediatR). Implements advanced pagination, multi-field dynamic sorting, and filtering. Features fine-grained resource-based authorization using custom ASP.NET Core requirements and handlers. Integrated with Serilog (Console, File, and Azure Application Insights) and Azure-ready infrastructure (App Service, Azure SQL, Blob Storage).

Advanced dynamic filtering, sorting, and pagination pipeline
Application Insights and Serilog structured telemetry logging
Azure SQL Database and Azure Blob Storage integrations

projects.title: Route E-Commerce API (7-Layer Onion Architecture)
projects.tagline: Route Diploma capstone with dual Identity contexts, Redis caching, and Stripe payments.
projects.description: Route E-Commerce API built with .NET 8 using Onion Architecture (7 layers), EF Core with two Identity contexts, JWT authentication, Redis caching for basket, Stripe payments, and Repository/Unit of Work patterns.
projects.fullDescription: Built during the Route Academy Diploma, this high-performance eCommerce API leverages Onion Architecture (7 layers) to isolate core business rules from external dependencies. Features include two separate Identity contexts, Redis distributed caching for shopping cart management, Stripe checkout integration, Generic Repository, Unit of Work, Specification, and Result patterns. Fully tested with an Angular client.
keyFeatures: Generic Repository and Unit of Work patterns for clean data access
Redis in-memory caching to boost product catalog and basket performance
Stripe payment gateway integration with webhook listeners
Specification pattern for dynamic filtering, sorting, and pagination

projects.title: From-Scratch Data Structures & Algorithms in C++
projects.tagline: Comprehensive C++ implementations organized into dedicated topic branches.
projects.description: From-scratch C++ implementation of Data Structures & Algorithms. Code is organized into dedicated branches per topic, featuring custom graph libraries, precise linear structures, and advanced algorithm strategies.
projects.fullDescription: A deep-dive, from-scratch algorithmic repository engineered in modern C++. Highly structured into dedicated Git branches for each topic: custom Graph libraries (BFS, DFS, Dijkstra, Bellman-Ford, Prim/Kruskal), dynamic Trees (BST, AVL, Segment Trees), Hash Tables with collision resolution, and advanced algorithmic paradigms including Dynamic Programming, Greedy, and Backtracking.
keyFeatures: From-scratch implementations of Graphs, Trees, Heaps, and Hash Tables
Dynamic Programming, Divide and Conquer, Greedy, and Backtracking algorithms
Git topic-branch workflow isolating algorithmic modules
Rigorous time and space complexity optimizations
